title: 第十九章 注入寿元练第二十章 朽木不可雕也
content_zh:
“我给你一条建议，最好是借助北国皇城的势力去面对封神盟，这样巅涯也要在三考量，不然你们这些人会很棘手的！”扬皓看事情已经没有扭转的余地了，给出了自己的建议。
魂纹太极大阵子阵把他们守护起来，所有太极图的阴阳二级如同一个个枪口，对着四周、空中不断的扫射，一头头妖兽在这密集的攻击下纷纷爆开，丢下一颗颗亮晶晶的晶体，彻底消散。
可因为祖灵、圣灵两大太祖的回归，使得寂灭三族看到了覆灭源界大军的希望。
陆山民朝这人点了点头，做到了罗兴的右侧，那人神色漠然，没有任何表情，淡淡的坐在了罗兴靠左侧的位置。
温缪看着赤成，抬起手，款款的摸了摸他脸上的血迹，那股狠辣的气息完全消失不见，看着眼前脸上血肉模糊的赤成，心疼的说到“二哥没事，倒是你，身上的伤要不要紧。。”温缪高高的昂起头，眼神关切的看着赤成。
只不过也不能多吸收，不然一旦体内的凶煞气息积累过多，就会影响心志甚至使人发疯。
“这是我们最好的机会了，错过了这个机会，我们就要终生受他桎梏了，你难道想就此受人奴役吗？”黑蛟疾言厉色。
山猫暗中松了口气，庆幸自己没有猜错，吕家果然有扶持吴峥上台的想法，只是还有些顾及。
更何况，在抵御这些怪狼的同时，他还必须时时刻刻提防着万永义有没有耍什么阴谋诡计。
见到很多熟悉的老面孔，回乡的那种感觉更加浓烈了，很想上去跟他们打声招呼，但理智让我止步了，避免节外生枝。
现场有了片刻的静默，就如一阵冷风袭过，让大家都有些没回过神来，但旋即就是比刚才更加激烈的哄堂大笑。
林长天要不是林紫玥和林娇娇的老爸，刘芒觉得，应该早就把他给宰了，那个家伙死了比活着要好的多。
然而，就在龙坤准备动手的时候，一道倩影突然出现在古锋身前挡住了他。
五天后，也就是谢彬第二次催动子母互信蛊到现在的第十天，终于他如愿以偿地获得了自己的那只母蛊。
我目瞪口呆，难道这也是防盗的一种手段吗？全部是黑土，罗盘又失效，到处打洞取土，就会沾染黑土上的毒气，久而久之就中毒了？如果真是这样，那就太可怕了。
“没什么事，刚才有野兽跑过来了而已。”秦海笑呵呵地说道，劝着柳轻眉赶紧回屋去，可是就在这时，秦海心中突然警兆大生，然后迅速将柳轻眉扑倒在地上。
“那可是一万两银票，你能替他还吗？”麻子脸轻蔑地瞅一眼上官飞。
风雷子凑到水晶墙跟前，仔细的瞅了瞅鲍鱼的嫩肉，明显是馋了。
这一刻，夜枫终于明白了——武技再好，终究只是死物，人，才是最为根本的。若是能将自己的情绪、灵魂融入自己的一招一式之中，那死物才会真正变成有灵之术，威力必将提升好几倍。
“我们魔尊虽是魔界之主，但是我们魔后却是天界的孕育之神。魔后生‘性’善良，所以少主品‘性’纯良也属正常。”水魔说道，眼睛紧紧的盯着龙灿儿的脸。

“你们是谁？为何闯进我的地盘？”就在众人好奇的看着那巨型娃娃之际，那巨型娃娃开口问道。
“阿黎，我没事！”那老头正不知所措时，龙灿儿睁开眼睛正看到这一幕，觉得甚是好笑，慌忙说道。
悟空进了洞内，见里边真的是别有洞天，简直就跟宫殿相仿，而宫内的穹顶和四壁更是镶嵌了无数璀璨的宝石，闪着冷冷的光，就好似无垠的夜空。
众人见是虚惊一场，纷纷松了口气，坐在原地等着飞儿好好消化。
想通了之后，秦斌不再停留，直接向大厅中走去，此时翟金国已经沉睡过去，一切以孟驼子和白祖武两人为主，此时孟驼子正在打坐修炼，有了秦斌激发出来的浓雾之后，那些人已经暂停了破阵，他也能抓紧时机休息一下。
“啪”地一声，一记简单直拳打出，几乎可以看见他的拳头所及之处，带起了一个个气流漩涡，急速地旋转，将空气打得啪啪作响。
管家柯胜恭敬有礼的向她汇报：“公主，府中一切安好，和往日一样，只是今天来了一个客人找您，他说是星宿七怪的老大，云姑娘把他先安顿住在了客房，公主您看这样妥不妥当”？
花圣抽离了身体，移到一边，一口血液脱口而出，喷了一地，血液都是呈黑色的……身体脱虚的她静静躺了许久，看着一旁熟睡中的的男子，露出了一丝微笑。
只是，没想到，自己的步子，走着走着，还是走到了她身边，却得用微笑掩饰，做一个安静的哑人。
尤其是当林美珊和李梦婷得知刘艺她们之前的身份以及现在的身份时，更是羡慕不已。
“我有点儿累，就不送你了。”林微微坐在沙发上纹丝未动，脸上挂着几分慵懒。
许言的脸又红了，想起昨晚上自己做的梦，她此时恨不得背后开个洞，溜了。
：。：

"I'll give you a suggestion. It's best to use the power of the Northern Imperial City to face the Conferred Gods Alliance. In this way, Dianya will have to think twice, otherwise you people will be in trouble!" Yang Hao saw that there was no room for turning things around, so he gave his own suggestion.
The Soul Pattern Taiji Formation protected them, and all the Yin and Yang Level 2 of the Taiji Diagram were like muzzles, firing continuously at the surroundings and in the air. The monster beasts exploded under this intensive attack, leaving behind sparkling crystals, which completely dissipated.
But because of the return of the two great ancestors, the Ancestral Spirit and the Holy Spirit, the Nirvana clan saw hope of destroying the Source Realm army.
Lu Shanmin nodded towards the man and moved to the right side of Luo Xing. The man looked indifferent and without any expression, and sat calmly on the left side of Luo Xing.
Wen Miao looked at Chi Cheng, raised his hand, and touched the blood on his face. The ruthless breath disappeared completely. Looking at the bloody face of Chi Cheng in front of him, he said distressedly, "Second brother is fine, but you, it doesn't matter if you are injured..." Wen Miao raised his head high and looked at Chi Cheng with concern.
It's just that you can't absorb too much, otherwise once the evil aura accumulates in the body too much, it will affect the mind and even make people crazy.
"This is our best opportunity. If we miss this opportunity, we will be shackled by him for the rest of our lives. Do you want to be enslaved by others?" Black Jiao spoke harshly.
Shanmao secretly breathed a sigh of relief, glad that he had guessed correctly. The Lu family really had the idea of ​​supporting Wu Zheng to come to power, but they still had some concerns.
What's more, while resisting these strange wolves, he must always be on guard against Wan Yongyi's conspiracy.
Seeing many familiar old faces, the feeling of returning to my hometown became stronger. I wanted to go up and say hello to them, but my reason stopped me to avoid unnecessary complications.
There was a moment of silence, like a gust of cold wind blowing through, leaving everyone stunned, but then the whole room burst into laughter even more intensely than before.
If Lin Changtian hadn't been the father of Lin Ziyue and Lin Jiaojiao, Liu Mang felt that he should have been killed long ago. That guy would be better off dead than alive.
However, just when Long Kun was about to take action, a beautiful figure suddenly appeared in front of Gu Feng and blocked him.
Five days later, which was the tenth day since Xie Bin activated the mother-child mutual trust Gu for the second time, he finally got his mother's Gu as he wished.
I was stunned. Is this also a way to prevent theft? It's all black soil, and the compass is ineffective. If you dig holes everywhere to get soil, you will be contaminated with the poisonous gas in the black soil, and you will be poisoned over time? If that were the case, that would be terrible.
"It's nothing, just a wild beast ran over just now." Qin Hai said with a smile, urging Liu Qingmei to go back to the house quickly, but at this moment, Qin Hai suddenly felt a warning sign in his heart, and quickly threw Liu Qingmei to the ground.
"That's a 10,000-tael silver note. Can you pay it back for him?" He glanced at Shangguan Fei with a pockmarked face.
Feng Leizi came closer to the crystal wall and took a closer look at the tender meat of the abalone. He was obviously greedy.
At this moment, Ye Feng finally understood - no matter how good his martial arts skills are, they are only dead things after all, and people are the most fundamental. If you can integrate your emotions and soul into your every move, then dead objects will truly become spiritual techniques, and their power will be increased several times.
"Although we, the Demon Lord, are the Lords of the Demon Realm, our Demon Queen is the nurturing god of the Heavenly Realm. The Demon Queen is born with a kind nature, so it is normal for the Young Master to be pure and kind." The water demon said, staring closely at Long Can'er's face.
"Who are you? Why did you break into my territory?" As everyone looked at the giant doll curiously, the giant doll asked.
"A Li, I'm fine!" When the old man was at a loss, Long Can'er opened his eyes and saw this scene. He thought it was very funny., said hurriedly.
Wukong entered the cave and saw that there was really a different cave inside, just like a palace. The dome and walls of the palace were inlaid with countless bright gems, shining coldly, just like the endless night sky.
Seeing that it was a false alarm, everyone breathed a sigh of relief and sat there waiting for Fei'er to digest it.
After thinking about it, Qin Bin stopped staying and walked directly into the hall. At this time, Zhai Jinguo had already fallen asleep, and everything was dominated by Meng Tuozi and Bai Zuwu. At this time, Meng Tuozi was meditating and practicing. With the thick fog inspired by Qin Bin, those people had stopped breaking the formation, and he could seize the opportunity to take a rest.
With a "pop" sound, a simple straight punch was delivered. You could almost see where his fist touched, creating air vortices, spinning rapidly, and making the air crackle.
The housekeeper Ke Sheng reported to her respectfully and politely: "Princess, everything in the house is fine, as usual. It's just that a guest came to see you today. He said he was the boss of the Seven Stars. Miss Yun settled him in the guest room first. Princess, do you think this is appropriate?"
The Flower Saint pulled away from her body, moved to the side, blurted out a mouthful of blood, and sprayed it all over the floor. The blood was black... She lay quietly for a long time after her body was exhausted, and looked at the sleeping man beside her, showing a smile.
However, I didn't expect that I would still reach her side as I walked, but I had to cover it up with a smile and become a quiet mute.
Especially when Lin Meishan and Li Mengting learned about Liu Yi's previous and current identities, they were even more envious.
"I'm a little tired, so I won't see you off." Lin Weiwei sat on the sofa without moving, with a bit of laziness on her face.
Xu Yan's face turned red again. Thinking of her dream last night, she wished she could open a hole in her back and escape.
